Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a TAP-tag to identify interactors of Scc1. Acquisition is explicitly DDA. Labeling is label-free (LFQ) as it uses a mock/untagged control for subtraction rather than isotopic tags.

scope: we performed a proteomic screen in budding yeast that identified the Isw1 chromatin remodeler as a cohesin binding partner
we pulled down Scc1 and performed mass spectrometry (MS) analysis of copurified proteins
we performed a single-step TAP purification using an untagged strain (mock sample) or a strain expressing Scc1-TAP, followed by identification of co-purifying proteins by MS
Resulting protein extracts were incubated with IgG Sepharose beads (GE Healthcare, 17-0969–01) for 2 h at 4°C with rotation
To release Scc1, IgG Sepharose beads were incubated overnight at 4°C in TEV buffer containing 400 U of TEV protease

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment involved the affinity purification of Scc1-TAP using IgG Sepharose beads and TEV protease release, identifying co-purifying proteins via LC-MS/MS.
